items.title: 10 Largest Companies that report earnings this week:
GlobalFoundries (GFS) secured a $2 billion agreement to manufacture silicon interposers for TSMC (TSM), strengthening its exposure to AI and high-performance computing.
items.quickTake: For TSM investors, the agreement could strengthen supply-chain flexibility and support advanced packaging capacity as AI demand grows.

items.title: SoftBank founder Masayoshi Son is seeking up to $100 billion from Gulf investors, with recent discussions involving senior UAE figures.
items.quickTake: SoftBank shares remain up 25% this year but have fallen more than 30% from their June peak, including a 5% drop on Friday.

attachedThreads.title: Anthropic reportedly aims to raise up to $100 billion through an IPO, potentially strengthening its ability to fund massive AI infrastructure spending.
attachedThreads.quickTake: At the quoted price near $355, AVGO trades around 36 times trailing adjusted earnings and 18 times expected fiscal 2027 earnings. The lower forward valuation depends on strong growth materializing; delays or funding problems at major AI customers could undermine that outlook.

items.title: SpaceX plans to acquire nationwide spectrum licenses covering up to 14 MHz in the 800 MHz band.
items.quickTake: The deal increases competitive pressure on traditional carriers, which formed a satellite-focused joint venture in May.

items.title: Starbucks has reportedly worked with advisers on a possible takeover of Chipotle, which has a market value of nearly $39 billion.
items.quickTake: The potential transaction comes amid increased dealmaking and expectations of lighter antitrust scrutiny under Trump; neither company confirmed the reported plans.

items.title: Oil rose 5% as tanker attacks and renewed Middle East tensions threatened supply, briefly pushing Brent above $105 before easing toward $104.
items.quickTake: Costly shipping arrangements and reduced refining capacity have amplified price increases: Brent was about 45% above its prewar level, while European diesel had nearly doubled.

attachedThreads.title: Peter Thiel’s investment firm, Thiel Macro, allocated 42% of its disclosed stock portfolio to Amazon and Vistra in Q2 2026.
attachedThreads.quickTake: Forecasts put the global AI market at $1.4 trillion by 2032, versus $618 billion in 2026, suggesting a substantial growth opportunity for Amazon, although forecasts are uncertain.

items.title: APLD rose nearly 5% premarket after fiscal Q1 results exceeded analysts’ expectations.
Global bond markets sold off again as investors worried about inflation, high public debt and elevated oil prices.
items.quickTake: Higher borrowing costs are spreading to households, with 30-year US mortgage rates reaching 7.49%; some investors now see long-term bonds as increasingly attractive.

attachedThreads.title: Long-term US Treasury yields have surged to decades-high levels, with the 30-year yield reaching 5.62% and the 10-year yield rising to 5.29%, driving up broad borrowing costs.
attachedThreads.quickTake: Major institutional managers remain cautious on duration, opting to trim underweight Treasury positions rather than actively buy the dip.

items.title: Oklo (OKLO) rose approximately +7% toward $40 as Google’s nuclear-power agreements boosted interest in the sector.
items.quickTake: Its development pipeline includes a 12-gigawatt master power agreement with Switch and a Meta prepayment agreement supporting a planned 1.2-gigawatt Ohio campus. These represent future opportunities, not operating capacity today.
